notes.title: Pumpkin ghost V3.0
notes.content:
Pumpkin ghost V3.0. Late Halloween update!
(I wanted this update out on Halloween but things came up and i didn't want to rush it.)

This update contains:
-New features-
A new mask system, there's now five masks to equip and collect that give you different advantages in battle.
There is now three save files you can use.
New dialogue and people to talk to.

-Graphical improvements-
New and improved grass.
More background details with new models.
Better leaf particle system.
improved textures.
improved all character models (for performance and how they look)
Teddy bear enemy has a new animation.
Standard ghost enemy has a new animation.

-Quality of life-
Chill mode has been made easier.
UI now show what difficulty you're on.
Entering stages now saves the game for you.
Players soul (Players hit box) is more visible.
Fire gals fire now has an animation (so now it doesn't fust pop out and get you).
Ghost cats laser now has an animation (so now it doesn't fust pop out and get you).

-new input options added-
You can now enter levels with "Space".
You can now use the shop with "Space".
You can now advance text in battle with "left click".
You can now advance text out of battle with "Space".
You can now pause game/mask menu with "ESC"

-Bug fixes-
You can now use the shop with the mouse after seeing a flashback.
You can no longer fall out of the world at the 12th rest stop.
When the level ends your shield automatically turns off.
Fixed some enemies that didn't die properly.

notes.title: Pumpkin Ghost V2.0 Update, new Challenges!
notes.content:
Pumpkin Ghost V2.0 Update, new Challenges!

New difficulty option!
-Three new difficulty options to tailor your experience.

New survival mode!
-Pick one of three loadouts and survive through a gauntlet challenge of all the levels together.

A new secret boss?
-See if you can find the secret boss and defeat it.

new optional side quest challenges!
-New challenges in the main campaign.

Improvements on textures!
Bug fixes!
